## The audited label artifact is ready for the next stage

The run produced **182,764 unique response judgments** across 6,816 questions
and 150 candidate models. Every record passed the frozen schema and identity
checks. The automated label is:

```text
supported = verdict in {correct, partial}
```

This definition deliberately separates factual support from completeness. A
response can therefore be incomplete but still count as supported when its
central answer agrees with the supplied evidence and does not contradict it.

| Readiness check | Result |
|---|---:|
| Unique records | 182,764 / 182,764 |
| Provider invariant failures | 0 |
| Deterministic invariant failures | 0 |
| Audited verdict changes | 55 |
| Explanation-only repairs | 4 |
| Estimated Batch cost | $31.82 |

## Curation reduced decision-level inconsistency

Exact-input duplicate analysis found 25 raw groups in which otherwise identical
judge inputs crossed the supported/unsupported boundary. Twenty clearly
adjudicable groups were canonicalized, leaving five ambiguous or broken-question
groups unchanged. Pairwise supported/unsupported disagreements fell from 303 to
171 among 58,909 duplicate pairs.

Five-way verdict differences that stay inside the same automated bucket are
retained as debugging detail. They do not change the downstream `supported`
label.

| Curated verdict | Count | Rate |
|---|---:|---:|
| correct | 114,319 | 62.55% |
| partial | 17,758 | 9.72% |
| incorrect | 10,402 | 5.69% |
| nonanswer | 23,539 | 12.88% |
| not_established | 16,746 | 9.16% |

## The semantic audit targeted both labels and explanations

A deterministic 103-record packet covered 20 examples from each raw verdict
plus explanation-integrity controls. Two supported/unsupported corrections from
that sample were applied. Four additional repairs changed explanations only.
After curation, no control characters remain in explanation text.

The audit supports operational use of the labels; it does not estimate absolute
answer correctness. The judge compared candidate responses with supplied,
grounded Gemini evidence after citations and model identity were withheld.
Gemini evidence can still be incomplete or wrong.

checksum manifest are preserved in both a local archive and a private Hugging
